zones.name: Navigation
zones.why: Global chrome. The nav persists across every page. A dark surface creates hard visual separation between product shell and page content.
zones.size: 48px = 2×24. Nav links need line-height:48px to fill the bar without align-items:center. Avatar (24×24 = 1 baseline) at padding-top:0. The "+ New Article" button fills the full 48px height.
zones.place: col 1–12, full bleed. Navigation always spans the full viewport.

zones.name: Separator
zones.why: Visual breathing room between nav (dark, heavy) and stat bar (light, informational). Background shift signals a section boundary without a hard border line.

zones.name: Stat Bar
zones.why: At-a-glance summary before users engage with the article list: total articles, published, drafts, connected platforms — the "dashboard at a glance" beat.
zones.size: 48px = 2×24. Large mono number (18px, line-height:24px) on baseline 1. Label (8px/700 UC) + sub-label (7px mono) fill baseline 2.
zones.place: col 1–12. 4 equal tiles, each 3 cols wide. Three-col tiles give room for number + label side-by-side.

zones.name: Separator
zones.why: Separates summary section (nav + stats) from action section (filters + list).

zones.name: Filter Bar
zones.why: Platform and status filters let users narrow the article list. White surface signals an interactive control row vs. the informational zones above.
zones.size: 24px = 1×24. Filter chips are exactly 24px (line-height:24px, no vertical padding).
zones.place: col 1–12. Directly above the article list — filter↔list relationship must be spatially immediate.

zones.name: Article Row 1
zones.why: Three text lines is the minimum meaningful representation of an article without reverting to a card layout.
zones.size: 72px = 3×24. Line 1: platform mono. Line 2: Georgia italic title. Line 3: category · word count. Three baselines, no spare space.
zones.place: col 1–12. Internal split: platform col 1–2, body col 3–9, word count col 10, status col 11 (padding-top:24px), date col 12.

zones.name: Article Row 2
zones.why: Alternating stripe — warmer background aids scanning without a visible border.

zones.name: Article Row 3
zones.why: Returns to white for alternating stripe. This row pattern repeats for all articles.

shapes.name: Nav extension
shapes.note: Extends the nav bar downward on the right — demonstrates merge mode
